goal: Prove the Khitmee backend sustains the 1-hour seasonal workload (100 and 125 vouchers/min plus managers) on a 2 vCPU / 2 GiB capped guest with exact stock-ERPNext parity; stock ERPNext/Frappe remains the untouched oracle. Integrates PR17 changes.
grill_summary: Integrates PR17 (merged into branch; PR17 need not merge). Base main. Oracle: stock ERPNext/Frappe never edited; mismatches reported with root cause. Acceptance: 1h seasonal (100/125 vouchers/min + managers) on 2vCPU/2GiB capped guest, p95 budgets, no OOM, no duplicate postings, exact parity. Architecture per ADR 0002 (GPT-6.2 Astra): keep transactional getseries, shrink post-naming work. Rust only for measured CPU-bound pure batch steps. Workers: SWE-2.1 standard / GPT-6.2 Sol. Review: deep (Astra) + cloud. Merge: auto.

oracle-2e42a4216873a48d.summary: OWNER POLICY (supersedes oracle-551519824ddf1eaa): for restricted actors, any Invoice/grouped/Warehouse/Monthly/CSV row, header, group or Total whose amounts depend on an in-range linked return hidden by the actor's Sales Invoice predicate keeps identity columns but has dependent financial cells blanked and flagged 'Restricted adjustment: Amounts withheld: linked return is outside your access'; affected inputs are excluded from arithmetic. Every value that IS shown equals stock ERPNext; unrestricted/Administrator output is identical to stock.
oracle-2e42a4216873a48d.why_ours_is_correct: Stock (gross_profit.py:717-750 lookup with no permission match condition; 596-597 fold; 624-647 amount updates) folds returns the user cannot open, disclosing hidden-document data through net amounts. Owner chose 'hide affected rows' (2026-11-28): withhold instead of leak or silently differ. Implemented in 8593c1b; manifest v3 signs visible+hidden dependency IDs.

oracle-551519824ddf1eaa.summary: For restricted actors, a submitted in-date linked return that stock Gross Profit folds into a visible invoice line is excluded when the actor's Sales Invoice permission predicate hides that return (interactive Invoice/grouped detail and CSV export alike). Unrestricted/Administrator output is unchanged and matches stock.
oracle-551519824ddf1eaa.why_ours_is_correct: Stock (gross_profit.py:717-750 lookup; 596-597 fold call; 624-647 amount updates; constructor 506-517) fetches linked return lines with docstatus/is_return/date/company filters and no permission match condition (717-750), then applies their quantities and amounts (624-647) without another ACL check, so a restricted user's totals disclose data from documents they cannot open. Ours applies the requester's Sales Invoice predicate to linked returns consistently across report and export. PENDING OWNER DECISION: match stock vs exclude hidden returns.
